sn46.40:1.1: Pañcime bhikkhave nīvaraṇā andhakaraṇā acakkhukaraṇā aññāṇakaraṇā paññānirodhikā vighātapakkhiyā anibbānasaṃvattanikā || ||
sn46.40:1.3: Kāmacchandanīvaraṇam bhikkhave andhakaraṇam āññāṇakaraṇam acakkhukaraṇam paññānirodhikaṃ vighātapakkhiyam anibbāna saṃvattanikaṃ ||
sn46.40:1.7: Vicikicchānīvaraṇam bhikkhave andhakaraṇam acakkhukaraṇam aññāṇakaraṇam aññānirodhikaṃ vighātapakkhiyam anibbānasaṃvattanikaṃ || ||
sn46.40:1.8: Ime kho bhikkhave pañcanīvaraṇā andhakaraṇā acakkhukaraṇā aññāṇakaraṇā paññānirodhikā vighātapakkhiyā anibbānasaṃvattanikā || || 3.
sn46.40:2.1: Sattime bhikkhave bojjhaṅgā cakkhukaraṇā ñāṇakaraṇā paññāvuddhiyā avighātapakkhiyā nibbānasaṃvattanikā || ||
sn46.40:2.3: Satisambojjhaṅgo bhikkhave cakkhukaraṇo ñāṇakaraṇo paññāvuddhiyo avighātapakkhiyo nibbānasaṃvattaniko || la-pe || || Upekhāsambojjhaṅgo bhikkhave cakkhukaraṇo ñāṇakaraṇo paññāvuddhiyo avighātapakkhiyo nibbānasaṃvattaniko || ||
sn46.40:2.4: Ime kho bhikkhave satta bojjhaṅgā cakkhukaraṇā ñaṇakaraṇā paññavuddhiyā avighātapakkhiyā nibbānasaṃvattanikāti || ||
